name: decay-warnings-list
description: List knowledge graph nodes flagged for principal re-confirmation before archival. DreamEngine flags important nodes — confidential/restricted, or connected to many other facts — and holds each for a 7-day window in which the principal can keep it (memory-confirm action confirm) or archive it now (memory-confirm action dismiss); otherwise it is archived when the window ends. Also call this when the principal asks to see what is going stale or needs their review. Returns nodeId, label, nodeType, sensitivity, edgeCount, reason (high_sensitivity/high_connectivity/both), daysRemaining, and warnedAt per warning. Sorted oldest-first. When nudging the principal, phrase by reason: high_sensitivity → "I have [label] on file but it's going stale — it's marked confidential. Is it still accurate?"; high_connectivity → "I have [label] on file but it's going stale — it's connected to [edgeCount] other facts in my notes. Is it still accurate?"; both → "I have [label] on file but it's going stale — it's confidential and well-connected. Is it still accurate?". State the time pressure using daysRemaining ("It'll be archived in [daysRemaining] days if I don't hear from you.").
